defmodule FileProcessor.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Cross-service authentication for file processing pipeline"

  @hmac_key Application.compile_env(:file_processor, :hmac_secret, "default_secret_key_32bytes_long!")
  @token_ttl_seconds 300

  defstruct [:service_id, :role, :timestamp, :signature]

  def verify_service_token(token_string) do
    with {:ok, parts} <- parse_token(token_string),
         {:ok, claims} <- validate_signature(parts),
         :ok <- check_expiry(claims) do
      {:ok, claims}
    end
  end

  defp parse_token(token_string) do
    case String.split(token_string, ".") do
      [service_id, role, timestamp, signature] ->
        {:ok, %__MODULE__{
          service_id: service_id,
          role: role,
          timestamp: String.to_integer(timestamp),
          signature: signature
        }}
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp validate_signature(%__MODULE__{} = token) do
    payload = "#{token.service_id}.#{token.role}.#{token.timestamp}"
    expected_sig = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, payload)
                   |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
    
    if expected_sig == token.signature do
      {:ok, token}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp check_expiry(%__MODULE__{timestamp: ts}) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if now - ts <= @token_ttl_seconds, do: :ok, else: {:error, :expired}
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.RoleResolver do
  @moduledoc "Resolves effective permissions from service role claims"

  @role_hierarchy %{
    "admin" => 100,
    "processor" => 50,
    "reader" => 10,
    "auditor" => 5
  }

  def effective_level(role) do
    Map.get(@role_hierarchy, role, 0)
  end

  def can_execute?(role, required_level) do
    effective_level(role) >= required_level
  end

  def normalize_role(role_string) do
    role_string
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.trim()
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.Pipeline do
  @moduledoc "File processing pipeline with role-based access control"

  alias FileProcessor.{Auth, RoleResolver}

  @processing_actions %{
    "read" => 10,
    "transform" => 50,
    "delete" => 100,
    "execute" => 100
  }

  def process_request(token_string, action, file_path) do
    with {:ok, claims} <- Auth.verify_service_token(token_string),
         {:ok, normalized_action} <- validate_action(action),
         :ok <- authorize(claims, normalized_action),
         {:ok, result} <- execute_action(normalized_action, file_path) do
      {:ok, result}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp validate_action(action) do
    normalized = String.downcase(String.trim(action))
    if Map.has_key?(@processing_actions, normalized) do
      {:ok, normalized}
    else
      {:error, :unknown_action}
    end
  end

  defp authorize(%Auth{} = claims, action) do
    required_level = Map.fetch!(@processing_actions, action)
    role = RoleResolver.normalize_role(claims.role)
    
    if RoleResolver.can_execute?(role, required_level) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :insufficient_privileges}
    end
  end

  defp execute_action("read", file_path) do
    safe_path = Path.expand(file_path, "/var/data/processing")
    if String.starts_with?(safe_path, "/var/data/processing") do
      case File.read(safe_path) do
        {:ok, content} -> {:ok, %{action: :read, content: content}}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      end
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    end
  end

  defp execute_action("transform", file_path) do
    safe_path = Path.expand(file_path, "/var/data/processing")
    if String.starts_with?(safe_path, "/var/data/processing") do
      {:ok, %{action: :transform, path: safe_path, status: :queued}}
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    end
  end

  defp execute_action("delete", file_path) do
    safe_path = Path.expand(file_path, "/var/data/processing")
    if String.starts_with?(safe_path, "/var/data/processing") do
      File.rm(safe_path)
      {:ok, %{action: :delete, path: safe_path}}
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    end
  end

  defp execute_action("execute", file_path) do
    safe_path = Path.expand(file_path, "/var/data/processing")
    if String.starts_with?(safe_path, "/var/data/processing") do
      {output, _} = System.cmd(safe_path, [])
      {:ok, %{action: :execute, output: output}}
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    end
  end
end
